Name: (CP) Updated Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade by DevilBro
Author: ursii98
Description:
[b][size=3]!!! THIS MOD WILL NOT BE UPDATED !!! I haven't had time to play in a long time, if anyone wishes to take over go ahead, have fun!
[/size][/b][size=3]And please don't massage me, if you want to use it, use it at your own risk.[/size]

UPDATE 4.0: I have added a file that is in beta once i know that the mod works i will publish all of the other versions as well.

UPDATE 3.0: removed the fireplace in the kitchen on a request.

This mod is originally from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2642839]DevilBro[/url]﻿.
I have made some modifications so that you have more options.

I have added:
- Bathroom without spouse room (removes spouse room)
- Bathroom without nursery (removes the crib and the 2 children beds)
- Bathroom without spouse room and without nursery (removes spouse room, the crib and the 2 children beds)

This mod needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿!

INSTALL:
1. Download the .rar file and unzip it to somewhere (i recommend desktop).
3. Put unziped file  inside the stradew valley -> mods.
4. You are done! Enjoy!
